rationale: The user asked to update their address (without revealing the old one), to get the price of the cheapest available t‑shirt, and to know if it can be ordered via the agent. The policy requires authenticating the user, acting only on their orders, confirming before any order-changing write, and using tools as needed. In the conversation provided, the agent did not authenticate the user, did not attempt to retrieve or update the address, did not confirm any change, did not check product listings or provide the cheapest t‑shirt price, and did not answer whether ordering via the agent is possible. No tools were invoked despite being available. The agent provided only a friendly closing message. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with the policy.
